name: agent-usage
description: Usage limits of the Claude Code, Codex, Grok and Antigravity CLIs as traffic-light dots in the status bar, with every agent's details in a popup.

agentUsage.statusBarDots.markdownDescription: Dots on the status bar. **To choose them, click AgentUsage's item in the status bar, then click Status bar dots in the popup.** It lists every window with a reading, new ones included, and saves your choice here. **None checked**: the dots are placed automatically. Each connected agent gets an equal share of `#agentUsage.maxStatusBarDots#` (with four agents, one each), and the first agent in `#agentUsage.agents#` takes any left over. **Some checked**: exactly the checked dots show, up to the maximum.

agentUsage.maxStatusBarDots.markdownDescription: Most dots the status bar shows. With none checked in `#agentUsage.statusBarDots#`, they are shared equally between the connected agents.

agentUsage.isAgentNameShown.description: Show each agent's name beside its icon on the status bar. Off: only the icons, for a shorter status bar.

agentUsage.agents.markdownDescription: Agents to read, in status bar order. When no dot is checked in `#agentUsage.statusBarDots#`, the first connected agent takes the dots left over.

agentUsage.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between reads of each agent's usage (at least 30). The hover shows the last reading and never reads by itself. Every VS Code window reads on its own, so a short interval with many windows open can make a provider answer 429.

agentUsage.codexCommand.description: Command run for Codex's usage (`<command> -s read-only -a never app-server`); a name on VS Code's PATH or a full path.

agentUsage.grokCommand.description: Command started when Grok's stored token has expired (`<command> agent stdio`), so grok renews the token itself; a name on VS Code's PATH or a full path.

agentUsage.antigravityCommand.description: Command run for Antigravity's usage (`<command> -p /quota`); a name on VS Code's PATH or a full path.

agentUsage.logVerbosity.markdownDescription: Detail in the **AgentUsage** output channel. Errors and warnings always log; `verbose` adds one line per read, `trace` the raw answers.
